context: You see this app in the app store, with this headline:

items.text: Someday - a shared bucket list for your close friends. Save the places and plans you want to do together.
Someday - stop planning in group chats. Keep every plan your friends make in one list.
Someday - plan it, do it, remember it. Plans and photos with your people.
Someday - never run out of weekend ideas with your friends.
Someday - a private space for your circle's plans, picks and memories.

good.text: Someday - a shared bucket list for friends. Save plans together, then actually do them.
